projection.rule: measured selection seconds/update and readout seconds; scoring from the measured per-cell rate x upper bounds (2000 cells, 600 novelty levels)

disclosures: F1 and F1-D were each selected on the policy split among three pre-declared learning rates; U had no such tuning (#127).
F1's training compute includes U's own training (Decision compute_and_queues).
G-action is inherited from U (below the 0.05 threshold in carrier space) and reported, not an F1 guard.

dispositions.1: X ranks launches better than U on the sealed NovPhy grid (scoped)
dispositions.2: U ranks launches better than X (scoped)
dispositions.3: No AUC difference of 0.02 or more

novelty.rule: P-novelty for F1 / F1-D (guard-passing, every seed); #129's frozen U+head every seed; NN exact-launch rule, missing support unavailable

recipe.sampler: nv.train_indices_sampler (32 + 32 with replacement) on eb.batch_rng(seed, b)

scope.declared: F1 is a native-success-readout follow-up on the #129 U+head route, not a member of #127's world-model disposition set; no new program-level claim is made (#141 ticket body).
scope.g_action: inherited from U and reported (U's per-seed carrier-space sensitivity on the cached 480 x 16 fit endpoints), not relaxed and not a G_* entry of F1 or F1-D (#127 issuecomment-6396584235).
scope.port: no new external code: A2's G-port / G-fid (#128) are inherited and reported, not re-run
scope.tokens: delta rule (#127) under this declared guard scope

selection_rule: largest policy-split pooled grid AUC at 4 d.p.; ties -> fewer trainable parameters -> declaration order; a configuration without an AUC is never selected

strata.metric: #128 NN-px metric: mean absolute difference in grey levels (uint8, 3 x 240 x 320) between the level's anchor frame 0 and the nearest of the 480 fit anchor frames (s128.pixel_orders)

u.name: unit
u.pairing: F1 seed s reads U seed s
